title: Sugar Crumble Palm Pudding
description: A sweet dessert made with palm sugar and topped with a crunchy crumble made from crumble ingredients.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine palm and sugar. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the palm is tender.
In a separate bowl, mix together crumble ingredients. Add a pinch of salt to taste.
Transfer the palm mixture to a baking dish and top with the crumble mixture.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown.
